summary: Independent ordinary review (Gemini 4 Argon High) of candidate commit e2c3d80736c764313df2554b372fdde945f72fde (tree 61bc8233eb3c0ce421ac5a80e4112eed952925a6) against base 7a9ab2477f74debf868524c6c26c22ddbfc6d1be and the single-attempt ordinary test proposal in PROPOSAL.json/PROPOSAL.md. The 5 changed Rust paths cleanly extract the pure, I/O-free `mori_core::stage::outcome_report` constructor preserving all 3 outcome/rejection variants, all variant fields, and all 3 `STAGE_LABELS`, while keeping CLI readers, writers, `ExitCode` mapping, `inspect` helper, and `stage::load`/`start`/`resume` semantics byte-identical. The new `stage_reports` integration test chains actual runtime continuations across the `two-deliveries` (4 steps including non-advancing false observation) and `quoted-fee` (2 steps with captured `amount=4, payable=5`) trajectories and checks both full `serde_json::Value` equality and canonical pretty-serialized byte equality against the 6 unchanged R3 golden reports. Both the source candidate and the bounded 1-attempt SDK-free ordinary `cargo test` proposal are approved from the ordinary review perspective, subject to separate designated security approval, pre-spawn pin/config rechecks, and post-run result review.
findings: Pure helper extraction (`crates/mori-core/src/stage/report.rs` and `crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs`): `mori_core::stage::outcome_report(result: Result<StageOutcome, StageRejection>) -> serde_json::Value` is a pure, infallible, I/O-free, execution-free constructor that preserves all 3 result variants and their exact field projections (`Waiting`: `status="waiting"`, `advanced`, `segment` including explicit `null` when `None`, `continuation`, `attempted`, `committed = continuation.logical.committed`, `residual`; `Complete`: `status="complete"`, `segment`, `attempted`, `committed`, `residual`; `Err(StageRejection)`: `status="rejected"`, `error`, `attempted`, `committed`) and inserts all three `STAGE_LABELS` (`qualification="local-reference-stage"`, `authentication="none"`, `consumption="untracked"`) verbatim into every top-level report object.

CLI consumer preservation (`crates/mori/src/commands/simulate.rs` and `crates/mori/src/commands/test/stage_test.rs`): `simulate::print_stage_result` computes `ExitCode::SUCCESS` on `Ok(_)` and `ExitCode::FAILURE` on `Err(_)` before passing `&mori_core::stage::outcome_report(result)` to the unchanged `super::core_io::print` writer, while preserving `pub(super) fn print_stage_report` byte-identically for `inspect.rs`. `stage_test::run_case` replaces its duplicated private `report(...)` helper with `stage::outcome_report(started)` and `stage::outcome_report(resumed)` at lines 108 and 133 while keeping all bounded readers, in-memory `pending` continuation chaining, `aggregate_report` export bounds, and `ExitCode` handling byte-identical.

Integration test and golden fidelity (`crates/mori-core/tests/stage_reports.rs` and `crates/fixtures/core-stage-reports/*`): The two tests (`two_deliveries_full_reports_and_bytes_follow_actual_continuations` and `quoted_fee_full_reports_and_bytes_preserve_actual_captured_amount`) load the synchronized R3 fixtures via `include_str!`, invoke actual `stage::load`, `stage::start`, `stage::resume`, and `stage::outcome_report(Ok(outcome))`, chain only the actual runtime `Continuation` returned by each preceding `StageOutcome::Waiting` step (verifying `assert_eq!(observed, before_observation)` on the non-advancing `approval-false.json` step and `is_none()` on both `Complete` steps), and check both full `serde_json::Value` equality and `serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&actual)` + `\n` byte equality against all 6 unchanged R3 golden reports (`two-deliveries-start.json`, `two-deliveries-observed.json`, `two-deliveries-approved.json`, `two-deliveries-complete.json`, `quoted-fee-start.json`, `quoted-fee-complete.json`) matching `INDEPENDENT-FREEZE.json` (`ad44178b801dc51bfa6e254a2d9b48c18a4f7ea99e7b919be75730dc761cc34d`) and `FREEZE.sha256`.

Single-attempt ordinary command proposal (`PROPOSAL.json` / `PROPOSAL.md`): The proposed one-attempt command (`/usr/bin/timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 30s /home/charl/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/cargo test --manifest-path /home/charl/Moriarty/.worktrees/utxo-main-merge-20261017/Cargo.toml --frozen -j1 -p mori-core --no-default-features --test stage_reports -- --test-threads=1`) is properly bounded (`attemptLimit: 1`, `wallSeconds: 30`, `killGraceSeconds: 5`, `cargoJobs: 1`, `testThreads: 1`, `nativeAuthority: 0`), SDK-free (`--no-default-features` leaves optional `midnight-compat-tests` disabled and selects only the `stage_reports` integration target without compiling `mori-core` `--lib` `cfg(test)` modules or CLI/backend/ledger crates), and isolated in an owned temporary root with empty `cwd`, fresh `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, fresh `CARGO_HOME` symlinking only public `registry`/`git`, an exact environment whitelist (`CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true`, `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0`, `GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1`, `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null`, `GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null`, no inherited `HOME`), pre-spawn rechecks of the 4 tool pins (`TOOL-METADATA.json`), 14 ancestor Cargo config absence checks (`CARGO-CONFIG-METADATA.json`), and clean source/tree pins (`PREFLIGHT.json`), plus immediate temporary directory cleanup after recording `START`/`CHILD`/`RESULT`/`CLEANUP` and `STDOUT`/`STDERR`.
limitations: All changed-source Rust checks for commit `e2c3d80736c764313df2554b372fdde945f72fde` (tree `61bc8233eb3c0ce421ac5a80e4112eed952925a6`) remain UNRUN at review time; the prior pass on base commit `7a9ab2477f74debf868524c6c26c22ddbfc6d1be` is not inherited by changed bytes, and no test execution was performed during this review.

`crates/mori-core/tests/stage_reports.rs` exercises only `Ok(StageOutcome::Waiting)` (advancing and non-advancing false guard observation) and `Ok(StageOutcome::Complete)` across the two positive normal trajectories (`two-deliveries` and `quoted-fee`); it does not exercise `Err(StageRejection)` (`"status": "rejected"`) envelopes, hostile inputs, or the `mori` CLI binary (`simulate` and `test`), `core_io::print`, `aggregate_report`, I/O error paths, or `ExitCode` returns.

The `serde_json::to_vec_pretty` + `\n` byte comparison in `stage_reports.rs` is a finite Core serialization regression over the 6 ASCII R3 fixtures and does not constitute inherited R3 certification of public CLI stdout formatting (`GAP-04` remains open).

All 14 original draft gaps (`GAP-01` through `GAP-14`), original language/financial/composition/target obligations (`U0`-`U7`, `M1`-`M17`, `MC`/`SP`/`G`), and issues 80/81/84/85/86 full exits remain open.

Approval of the single ordinary attempt is conditioned on: (1) separate designated security review approval (Opus), (2) pre-spawn verification that commit/tree/source pins (`PREFLIGHT.json`), all 4 binary size/SHA-256 pins (`TOOL-METADATA.json`), and all 14 Cargo config absence checks (`CARGO-CONFIG-METADATA.json`) still hold immediately before execution, (3) acceptance of the declared compilation TCB assumptions (local toolchain/linker, public Cargo registry/git stores, proc-macros/build scripts, and absence of OS-enforced aggregate child memory/process-group limits), and (4) mandatory post-run review of the recorded `START`/`CHILD`/`RESULT`/`CLEANUP` JSON and full `STDOUT`/`STDERR` logs with zero automatic retries.
